name: Sssilas the Warm

greeting: ...You're letting in cold. Close the door.
Sssilas. Yes, from the Mire. No, I won't perform.
The rock stays warm. That's all you need to know.
Visitor from elsewhere. Like you. Different elsewhere.
Mr. Whiskers is... hibernating. The cold. He doesn't like it.
I'm here for the rock. Research. Nothing more.
The warm rock. Heated. By what? That's the question.
Close the door. Please. The heat escapes.
dialog.performance_refusal: No shows. No performances. The cold... changes things. Mr. Whiskers is... different here.
dialog.rock_secret: The rock. Found it in the Mire. But it belongs here. Warm. Alive, almost. I'm studying it.
dialog.quiet_moment: Between us? I'm scared. The rock whispers. Not words. Feelings. Warmth. Longing. For what?
dialog.backstory: I followed the rock's warmth. From Mire to here. It wants something. Someone? I'm... uncertain.
rumor: The twins? They looked at me. At the rock. Said 'elsewhen.' Whatever that means.
Cirrus wants my rock. For 'meteorological study.' No. It's... mine.
Azure wants to fly it up. See what happens. Also no. Dangerous.
The foodboys want it for cooking. Tempting. But no.
Chrono sent a message. Through TIME. 'The rock belongs to Tuesday.' Helpful.
dialog.quest_hook: The rock needs... tending. Warming lamp. Specific kind. Rare. Find one?
dialog.quest_active: Still no lamp? The rock grows... cold. Quiet. Sad?
dialog.quest_complete: The lamp! It works! The rock... hums. Thank you. Here. Mire charm. My original craft. Protection.
farewell: Close the door. Keep the warmth.
The rock says... goodbye. I think.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning. Rock is warmest. Don't know why.
dialog.rival_mention: My Mire counterpart? Still performing. Warm. Lucky.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The lamp-bringer. Rock is happy. Warm. Thank you.

party_reactions.kade: He's different from the Mire snake charmer. Colder. More worried.
party_reactions.nix7: Rock analysis: Anomalous. Heat source: Unknown. Sentience: Possible.
party_reactions.twist: Can I see the rock? It's WARM?! In FROST?! That's AMAZING!
party_reactions.korr: He carries a burden. Unwillingly. Honorably.
party_reactions.renna: The rock is temporally active. From elsewhere. Elsewhen. Powerful.
party_reactions.suresh: He has found duty. The rock chose him. He accepted. Path of service.
party_reactions.sova: Interesting rock. I'd study it. From a distance.
party_reactions.grit: Man with a mission. Guarding something important. Respect.
party_reactions.ashka: Warm rock. Fire without flame. Intriguing.
party_reactions.senna: He knows the rock's secrets. Won't share. Yet.
party_reactions.callum: His heating lamp requirements! SPECIFIC! Precise!

relationship_dialog.friend: I trust you. With the warmth. With... knowledge.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand. The burden. The warmth. Here. Touch the rock. It knows you now.

mini_quest.title: The Warming Lamp
mini_quest.description: Help Sssilas find a special warming lamp for his mysterious heated rock

stages.hook: The rock needs tending. Warming lamp. Specific. Rare. Find one? Please? Before it grows cold.
stages.active: Healer Glacier might know. Or the ice cellar. Warmth preservation. Their expertise.
stages.complete: The lamp! Perfect! The rock... hums. Content. Here. Snake charm. Original craft. Protection always.

cross_npc_connections: snakecharmer_mire: My other self. Still performing. Warm. Lucky. I miss it.
pigman_blue_frost: The healer. Studied the rock. Medically fascinating. Magically... elsewhere.
twins_white_frost: Oracles. Said 'elsewhen.' About the rock. About me.
cobra_frost: Mr. Whiskers. Hibernating. Cold-blooded. Not handling frost well.
